BLOOD_PENDANT.description:
At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{CrimsonRagePower}[/blue] [gold]Pain[/gold].
While below 50% HP, gain [blue]25%[/blue] crit rate.
BLOOD_PENDANT.flavor: A pendant with a dull crimson sheen; every pulse sets the blood racing.
BLOOD_PENDANT.title: Blood Pendant
BLOOD_THORN.description: Whenever you take attack damage from an enemy, apply [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Bleed[/gold] to it.
BLOOD_THORN.flavor: Unseen thorns flow within your blood; every wound makes the enemy pay.
BLOOD_THORN.title: Blood Thorn
CRIMSON_PACT.flavor: Ink of blood, pact of pain. Once signed, suffering becomes strength.
CRIMSON_PACT.title: Crimson Pact
BLOOD_AMULET.flavor: A cold, blood-red charm that turns the wearer’s spilled blood into a barrier.
BLOOD_AMULET.title: Blood Amulet
COAGULATION_BANDAGE.description: The first time you lose HP each turn, draw [blue]1[/blue] card.
COAGULATION_BANDAGE.flavor: Special bandages that stanch the bleeding in an instant, turning pain into the will to fight on.
COAGULATION_BANDAGE.title: Coagulation Bandage
CRIMSON_RING.description: At the start of your turn, apply [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Bleed[/gold] to the enemy with the highest HP.
CRIMSON_RING.flavor: The inside of the ring is lined with fine barbs. Once worn, it cannot be removed, as if fused with flesh and blood.
CRIMSON_RING.title: Crimson Ring
BERSERKER_HELM.flavor: A helmet caked with dried blood, inscribed on the inside: "Pain is power."
BERSERKER_HELM.title: Berserker Helm
BLOOD_BIBLE.flavor: A scripture written in blood, each page recording the mysteries of pain.
BLOOD_BIBLE.title: Blood Bible
BLOOD_MOON_SHARD.description: The amount of [gold]Bleed[/gold] you apply is doubled.
BLOOD_MOON_SHARD.flavor: A deep crimson shard from a shattered blood moon; an undying crimson light still flows along its edges.
BLOOD_MOON_SHARD.title: Blood Moon Shard
SACRIFICIAL_ALTAR.description:
At a [gold]Rest Site[/gold] you may [gold]Sacrifice[/gold]: permanently lose [blue]6[/blue] max HP and choose one of the following:
+[blue]2[/blue] [gold]Pain[/gold] at the start of each combat; attacks apply +[blue]3[/blue] [gold]Bleed[/gold]; or base crit rate +[blue]10%[/blue].
Sacrificed so far: [blue]{PainSac}[/blue] Pain/combat, [blue]{BleedSac}[/blue] Bleed/hit, [blue]{CritSac}[/blue]% crit.
SACRIFICIAL_ALTAR.flavor: The remains of an ancient altar, still bearing the faint stains of dried blood.
SACRIFICIAL_ALTAR.title: Sacrificial Altar
ANCESTORS_BLOOD.description:
Gain [blue]1[/blue] additional [gold]Energy[/gold] each turn. You cannot heal at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold].
After each combat, heal [green]{Heal}%[/green] of your max HP.
ANCESTORS_BLOOD.flavor: The power of an ancient bloodline surges within you, granting endless vigor yet rejecting all mortal healing.
ANCESTORS_BLOOD.title: Ancestors’ Blood
BLOOD_HEART.description:
At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{CrimsonRagePower}[/blue] [gold]Pain[/gold].
While below 50% HP, gain [blue]40%[/blue] crit rate.
BLOOD_HEART.flavor: The Blood Pendant has taken root deep in your heart. The ancient bloodline’s power fully awakens, and pain and fury rage within it without end.
BLOOD_HEART.title: Bloodline Heart
